For each replicate measurement, 5 DGRP females were housed with standardised mates and opposite-sex competitors (15 males and 10 females, giving an overall population size of 30 and 1:1 sex ratio). Fitness was estimated on the latent scale from a generalised linear mixed model, and is scaled to have a mean of zero and unit variance.
